item.title: ‘Rumi in a Ramyeon Cup’ Is the Must-Have 3D Puzzle Inspired by HUNTR/X’s Hungry Lead Singer
item.description:
Here's a short and engaging podcast script:
[Intro music plays]
Host: "Hey there, K-Pop fans! Are you looking for the hottest toy of the year? Well, we've got the scoop. Introducing Rumi in a Ramyeon cup, the latest merch release from Netflix's K-Pop Demon Hunters. This adorable 3D puzzle is flying off the shelves, and we're here to tell you all about it."
[Cut to a brief musical transition]
Host: "So, what is this puzzle all about? It's a 138-piece 3D puzzle that forms a standing figurine of Rumi eating her favorite ramyeon, or Korean instant noodles. And the best part? It's only $19.99, with a 9% discount available on Walmart and Amazon."
[Cut to another brief musical transition]
Host: "But that's not all. This puzzle also comes with a 2-in-1 building kit that lets you build a larger ramyeon cup for Rumi to sit in. And, fun fact, the puzzle pieces are made of pre-cut foam, so no glue or tools are needed for assembly. Plus, the finished product is approximately 7.8 x 15 inches in size, making it a great addition to any K-Pop fan's room."
[Cut to another brief musical transition]
Host: "And if you're looking for more K-Pop Demon Hunters merchandise, we've got you covered. There's also a Derpy Tiger and Sussie Bird 3D puzzle kit, a Chibi collectible puzzle model kit featuring the entire HUNTR/X crew, and even a 3D sneaker puzzle that doubles as a desk decor. All of these items are available on Walmart and Amazon, so be sure to check them out."
[Outro music plays]
Host: "Thanks for tuning in, and don't forget to follow us for more K-Pop updates and merchandise news. Happy shopping, and we'll see you in the next episode!"
[Outro music continues to play until the end of the podcast]
